title: profile not coming back 100%
symptom: After upgrading from dev-c to dev-d, when Automation sets the profile to a desired value and time, after that time the profile does not set itself back to 100%. The profile remains at the temporary value (e.g., 130% or 90%) indefinitely.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. MilosKozak speculates the only possible reason is when the pump is not reachable, but the user reports the pump was reachable. The user suspects a build issue due to overloaded servers, but this is not confirmed.
fix: The user reverted to the older version (dev-c) and the profiles changed as expected. Later, they rebuilt the APK and installed it with a virtual pump, and it worked fine, but they planned to test for 2 days. No permanent fix is stated.
evidence_quote: I went back to the older version of Dev-c and the profiles change as they should
